name: Multi-agent LLM internalization itemized plan
purpose: Convert the post-baseline externalization result from Item095 into a staged internalization execution plan where every step becomes its own ledger item. The plan distinguishes externalized method evidence, trace harvesting, trace-to-SFT dataset construction, policy LoRA under an external scaffold, register-in-text internalization, and finally multi-agent internalized LoRA controls.

code_added_used.change: Adds an itemized route from externalized M-register evidence to trace harvesting, SFT datasets, policy LoRA, register-in-text evaluation, and multi-agent internalized LoRA controls.

commands.purpose: Record the internalization route before starting trace/export/training work.

headline.first_executable_stage: single-agent M-register step-level trace schema and harvester
headline.long_horizon_target: multi-agent LLM internalization with external controller/register removed
headline.key_rule: No training item may claim internalization while the external scaffold still owns the register or controller.

gate_outcomes.number: Items096-105 are enumerated with artifact target, pass gate, and does-not-establish guard.
Item097 is explicitly routed before SFT/LoRA.
Internalization is defined as removal of external register/controller ownership, not merely LoRA under the scaffold.

decision.next_step_routing: Execute Item097 single-agent M-register trace schema and harvester, then Item098 multi-agent trace pilot before any training.

rows.pass_gate: branch/backtrack/final trace rows export and solve
chat-format train/val splits with leakage checks
team agents maintain registers and communicate conflicts
rows.does_not_establish: full claim unless n>=30 per K

rows.pass_gate: scale successful setting or bank scoped negative

honesty.does_not_establish: This is a plan item only. It does not generate traces, train LoRA adapters, or evaluate internalized agents.
honesty.routing_limit: The route may be revised only by a future item with explicit gates and numbers, not by silently skipping trace or control stages.
